title: Context-Grounded Skill Internalization for Vision-Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30075v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Skill internalization offers a way for agents to learn useful behaviors from skills and use them without explicit guidance in context at inference time. A common approach is to generate demonstration trajectories with the skill in context and then fine-tune the same model on its own trajectories with the skill removed. However, this leads to the problem that the model may learn to reference the removed skill, which we named as context misalignment (CoMi). In this work, we first analyze agent behaviors related to CoMi under this common pipeline. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ARC-AGI-1, skill-removed fine-tuning consistently results in CoMi: 12.2-46.0% of test trajectories reference the removed skill. To address this problem, we develop Context-Grounded Skill Internalization (CGSI). CGSI uses a sentence detector to identify unsupported references and then masks or rewrites the selected sentences before fine-tuning. Experimental results dem

translated_title: 面向视觉语言代理的上下文锚定技能内化
translated_abstract: 技能内化为代理提供了一种从技能中学习有用行为的方法，使其在推理时无需上下文中的显式引导即可运用这些行为。一种常见做法是：在上下文中包含技能的情况下生成演示轨迹，然后在移除技能的情况下对该模型自身生成的轨迹进行微调。然而，这会导致模型可能学会引用已被移除的技能的问题，我们将其命名为上下文错位。在这项工作中，我们首先分析了这种常见流程下与CoMi相关的代理行为。在ALFWorld、WebShop和ARC-AGI-1三个环境中，移除技能后的微调始终导致CoMi：12.2%至46.0%的测试轨迹引用了被移除的技能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了上下文锚定技能内化（CGSI）。CGSI使用句子检测器识别无依据的引用，然后在微调之前对所选句子进行掩码或重写。实验结果表明……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文提出CGSI方法，通过句子检测器识别并掩码或重写微调数据中引用已移除技能的句子，有效解决了技能内化中的上下文错位（CoMi）问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CGSI, which uses a sentence detector to identify and mask or rewrite unsupported skill references before fine-tuning, effectively addressing the context misalignment (CoMi) problem in skill internalization.
